body:
## Summary

- **Bug:** Solo-owner security-release policy assumed GitHub `authorAssociation=OWNER`. On organization-owned repositories (`DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp`), the sole trusted human maintainer is reported as **`MEMBER`**, so legitimate exact-head solo authorization was rejected early.
- **Fix:** Define `_SOLO_OPERATOR_ASSOCIATIONS = {OWNER, MEMBER}` for PR author association, authorization-comment association, and receipt generation. Add fail-closed `SOLO_OWNER_ASSOCIATION_MISMATCH` when both associations are present and differ.
- **Unchanged:** Exact single-person trusted roster; `COLLABORATOR` rejected; non-author trusted approver disables solo path; exact PR number + full 40-char head SHA; audit/proof/CI/review-thread/reviewer-classification/harvest/mixed-SHA gates independently blocking; auto-merge disabled; solo receipt never becomes a fabricated GitHub review.
- **Not this PR:** Does **not** approve or modify product PR **#1126**. Does **not** authorize deployment. Does **not** change the organization-owned GitHub App security-release path from PR **#1133**.

## Trust-root bootstrap

This PR changes `tools/pr_steward/**`, so the currently deployed solo-owner path on `main` may still reject `MEMBER` authorization for **this** PR. Expected Steward status before merge may be `NEEDS_SUPERVISOR` with sole blocker `SECURITY_RELEASE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` (association recursion). One-time administrative bootstrap merge is authorized **only** for this association-repair PR when CI is green, proof/audit pass, allowlist holds, and the sole Steward blocker is that recursion. Auto-merge must not be used.

## Packet

- `TP-PRSTEWARD-SOLO-OWNER-ORG-MEMBER-001`
- Parent: `ADR-DMX-PRSTEWARD-SOLOOWNER-001` / PR #1131
- Embedded audit: **PASS_WITH_RISKS** (Claude Code CLI Sonnet, independent session)
- Proof: `proof/TP-PRSTEWARD-SOLO-OWNER-ORG-MEMBER-001/`

## Test plan

- [x] `python -m compileall -q tools/pr_steward`
- [x] `uv run pytest -q tests/pr_steward/test_solo_owner_security_release.py tests/pr_steward/test_classifier_solo_owner.py tests/pr_steward/test_trusted_security_approvers.py tests/pr_steward/test_security_release_approval.py`
- [x] `uv run pytest -q tests/pr_steward/` (zero failures)
- [x] `PYTHONPATH=. python -m tools.pr_steward.intake --help`
- [x] `git diff --check`
- [x] pre-commit on allowlisted files
- [ ] CI green on this PR head
- [ ] After merge: re-run Steward on #1126 at exact head `ba8a78fa1ed09dc0d7cbb9f2b2680508c6fa13a3` (do not repost phrase unless head changes)

commits.messageBody:
GitHub reports organization maintainers as MEMBER, not OWNER. Expand the
solo-owner security-release association set to {OWNER, MEMBER}, reject
COLLABORATOR, and fail closed on PR/comment association mismatch.

Does not approve PR #1126, authorize deployment, or change the org-owned
app approval path. Trust-root bootstrap PR for ADR-DMX-PRSTEWARD-SOLOOWNER-001.

Packet: TP-PRSTEWARD-SOLO-OWNER-ORG-MEMBER-001
